_comment: Two grades, renamed from an earlier Common/Legendary pair to a Legendary/Mythic pair - values on the eight relics below are unchanged, only the grade label moved. A LEGENDARY relic is a stat bundle: it carries a 'stats' block, never a 'hook', and resolves entirely in StatMath.ApplyRelic before the simulation starts. A MYTHIC relic carries a 'hook' plus a 'stats' block stacked on top of it - the hook is its unchanged unique passive, the stats are new as of this rename. Its 'rule' still states the hook as one sentence with no number in it; the numbers for a mythic relic live in 'stats', same as a legendary's. ContentDatabase drops a mythic entry with no hook and a legendary entry with either a hook or an empty stats block. 'mode' is Multiply for Attack/Defense/MaxHp/Speed (large scaled numbers - value 0.14 means x1.14) and Add for CritChance/CritDamage/EffectHit/EffectResist (small fractions that are never scaled by level or star rarity - value 0.12 means +0.12). The four relics cut in the prior rewrite (Splitting Prism, Warden's Debt, Stormlance Oath, Verdict Sigil) and the two cut before that (Tidewrought Metronome, Green Hour Vessel) all stay cut - unaffected by this rename.
_valuesComment: All twenty numbers below are first-pass and unbalanced by admission, not by oversight. They have not been through RunCampaignBalancePass. DESIGN-RELICS task 13's retune is the only pass that produces real values. The two mythic relics' stat additions (Speed/Effect Resist on The Unbroken Ledger, Effect Hit/Crit Damage on Mirrored Wound) are sized deliberately modest relative to the eight legendary relics' pairs, since most of a mythic relic's power budget is already spent on its unique passive - the stat block is a bonus stacked on top, not a second reason to equip it.
